# The whole-domain appearance sweep's baseline: every property violation the
# shipped renderer still draws over the contract domain, frozen here before the
# renderer tasks of the watch/setup contract move it.
#
# One line per violation band — <property> <columns> <rows> — where each side is
# a single size or an inclusive lo-hi range, and either may list comma-separated
# ranges. A band expands to one entry per violating (property, columns, rows)
# triple, and the sweep compares the expanded sets by subset: a renderer fix
# that clears part of the domain shrinks the observed set and stays green, while
# a violation this file does not name is a regression and fails.
#
# Bands rather than one line per triple, for one measured reason: the expansion
# is 33510 triples and committing them verbatim is some 600KB of fixture — past
# the verifiable diff cap every gate on this run measures. The comparison is
# per-violation either way; only the storage is folded.
#
# The two header bands are the renderer's, not the oracle's: below 19 rows the
# header row is surrendered outright, and between 93 and 96 columns the brand
# word is overrun by the run id and paints as "tickmarkrun-…". The signature is
# counted at any indentation, so the inset header every wider frame draws is
# read as the one header it is.
tiles 40-220 14-50
header 40-92,97-220 14-18
header 93-96 14-50
mark 40-220 14-50
keybar 40-220 14-50
sidebar-content 64-220 14-50
sidebar-gutter 64-220 14-50
sidebar-focus 40-63 19-50
